en: The postcard features an ornate black-and-white image of a large church interior with high vaulted ceilings, gothic arches, chandeliers, wooden pews, an organ, and a detailed pulpit. The text on the front reads 'Sundsvall' and 'Det inre af kyrkan' (Swedish for 'The interior of the church'). The reverse side has handwritten Swedish addresses and a green Swedish stamp (5 öre, SVERIGE), with a partial postmark visible.
